USER.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_user(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,name TEXT,password TEXT, username TEXT UNIQUE,mobile TEXT,emailid TEXT, role INTEGER, active INTEGER, image TEXT, created_by Integer, created_date TEXT, modify_by Integer, modify_date TEXT)
USER.SELECT_USER_NAME: SELECT name, active FROM <>_user WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE
USER.SELECT_USER_NAME_PASS: SELECT id, name,emailid, mobile, username, role, password, active FROM <>_user WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE
USER.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_user (name, password, username, mobile, emailid, role, active, image, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, ?, ?,?,?,?,?, datetime('now', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes'))
USER.SELECT_ALL: Select id,name, emailid, role,username, mobile, image, active from <>_user
USER.SELECT_USER: select id, name, username,role, emailid, mobile, active, image from <>_user
USER.SELECT_USER_BY_ROLE: select id,name, username, role, emailid, mobile, image, active from <>_user WHERE {conditions}
USER.SELECT_USER_BYID: select id,name, role, username, emailid, mobile, active, image from <>_user where id = ?
USER.SELECT_USER_BYEMAILID: select id,name, role, username, emailid, mobile, active, image from <>_user where emailid = ? Limit 1
USER.SELECT_USER_NAME_PASSById: SELECT id, name, username, role, password,emailid, active FROM <>_user WHERE id = ?
USER.SELECT_SALESPERSON_DEVICE_TOKEN: SELECT n.device_id FROM <>_notification AS n INNER JOIN <>_user AS u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role in ( ?, ?,?) ORDER BY n.id DESC
USER.SELECT_DEVICE_TOKEN_BY_USERID: SELECT DISTINCT n.device_id FROM <>_notification AS n INNER JOIN <>_user AS u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = ? OR u.role IN (?, ?) ORDER BY n.id DESC;
USER.SELECT_DEVICE_TOKEN_SALESHEAD_ADMIN: SELECT n.device_id FROM <>_notification AS n INNER JOIN <>_user AS u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role in ( ?, ?) ORDER BY n.id DESC

LEAD.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_lead(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT,company_name TEXT, city TEXT,state TEXT, contact_number TEXT, enquiry_type TEXT, email TEXT, requirement TEXT, stage TEXT, next_followup TEXT, status TEXT, assigned_to Integer, assigned_by Integer, active INTEGER, created_by Integer,created_date TEXT, modify_by Integer, modify_date TEXT)
LEAD.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_lead(name ,company_name, city, state, contact_number, enquiry_type, email, requirement, active, status, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1,'open',?, datetime('now', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes'))
LEAD.SELECT_ALL: SELECT a.id,a.name,a.company_name, a.city,a.state,a.contact_number, a.enquiry_type, a.email, a.requirement, a.stage, a.next_followup, a.status,a.created_date, a.assigned_to, a.modify_date,  COALESCE(b.name, 'Unassigned') AS assigned_user FROM <>_lead AS a LEFT JOIN <>_user AS b ON a.assigned_to = b.id WHERE 1=1 {conditions} ORDER BY a.id desc LIMIT ?
LEAD.SELECT_BY_LEADID: select * from <>_lead where id = ? and active = 1
LEAD.COUNT: SELECT CASE WHEN status IS NULL OR TRIM(status) = '' THEN NULL WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) LIKE '%CLOSE%' THEN 'Closed' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) LIKE '%OPEN%' THEN 'Open' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) LIKE '%INPROGRESS%' THEN 'Inprogress' ELSE 'Open' END AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM <>_lead GROUP BY CASE WHEN status IS NULL OR TRIM(status) = '' THEN NULL WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) LIKE '%CLOSE%' THEN 'Closed' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) LIKE '%OPEN%' THEN 'Open' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) LIKE '%INPROGRESS%' THEN 'Inprogress' ELSE 'Open' END;
LEAD.COUNT_BY_USER: SELECT CASE WHEN status IS NULL OR TRIM(status) = '' THEN NULL WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) LIKE '%CLOSE%' THEN 'Closed' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) LIKE '%OPEN%' THEN 'Open' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) LIKE '%INPROGRESS%' THEN 'Inprogress' ELSE 'Open' END AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM <>_lead WHERE (assigned_to IS NULL OR assigned_to = ?) GROUP BY 1;
LEAD.INSERT_BULK_LEAD: INSERT INTO <>_lead(name ,company_name, city, state, contact_number, enquiry_type,  email, requirement, stage, next_followup, active, status, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

PROJECT.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_project(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, lead_id INTEGER, stage TEXT, next_followup TEXT, status TEXT, assigned_to Integer, assigned_by Integer, active INTEGER, created_by Integer,created_date TEXT, modify_by Integer, modify_date TEXT)
PROJECT.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_project(lead_id, stage, status, active, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, ?, ?, datetime('now', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes'))
PROJECT.SELECT_ALL: select a.*, COALESCE(b.name, 'Unassigned') AS assigned_user, c.*  from <>_project as a left join <>_user as b on a.assigned_to = b.id left join <>_lead as c on a.lead_id = c.id WHERE 1=1 {conditions} ORDER BY a.id LIMIT ? ;
PROJECT.SELECT_BY_PROJID: select * from <>_project where id = ? and active = 1
PROJECT.COUNT: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM <>_project GROUP BY status;
PROJECT.COUNT_BY_USER: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM <>_project where (assigned_to is NULL) OR assigned_to = ? GROUP BY status;

LEAD_TIMELINE.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_leadtimline(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, lead_id INTEGER, message TEXT, docs_urls TEXT, created_by Integer,created_date TEXT)
LEAD_TIMELINE.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_leadtimline(lead_id, message, docs_urls, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, ?, datetime('now', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes'))
LEAD_TIMELINE.SELECT: SELECT a.*, COALESCE(b.name, 'Unassigned') AS created_from FROM <>_leadtimline as a left join <>_user as b on a.created_by = b.id  where a.lead_id = ?

PROJECT_TIMELINE.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_projecttimline(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, project_id INTEGER, message TEXT, docs_urls TEXT, created_by Integer,created_date TEXT)
PROJECT_TIMELINE.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_projecttimline(project_id, message, docs_urls, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, ?, datetime('now', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes'))
PROJECT_TIMELINE.SELECT: SELECT a.*, COALESCE(b.name, 'Unassigned') AS created_from FROM <>_projecttimline as a left join <>_user as b on a.created_by = b.id where project_id = ?

COMPANY.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,name TEXT UNIQUE, aliasname TEXT, active INTEGER, created_date TEXT) ;
COMPANY.INSERT: INSERT INTO company (name, aliasname, active, created_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?, datetime('now', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')) ;
COMPANY.SELECT_COMPANY_NAME: SELECT name FROM company WHERE name = ? ;
COMPANY.SELECT_COMPANY_ALIASNAME: SELECT name FROM company WHERE aliasname = ? COLLATE NOCASE ;

NOTIFICATION.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_notification(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER, device_id TEXT, created_date TEXT)
NOTIFICATION.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_notification (user_id, device_id, created_date) VALUES (?, ?, datetime('now', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes'))
NOTIFICATION.SELECT: SELECT * FROM <>_notification WHERE user_id = ? AND device_id = ? order by id desc limit 1
NOTIFICATION.SELECT_ALL: SELECT id, device_id, created_date FROM <>_notification WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?
